name: Commercial Holiday Lighting Services
metaTitle: Commercial Holiday Lighting Services | Ontario Firms
metaDescription: Turnkey commercial holiday lighting for Ontario and GTA businesses, design through storage in one program. Multi-year options, one contact. Get a quote.
heroIntro: A complete commercial program covering design, supply, installation, maintenance, removal and storage under one point of contact.
intro: Managing holiday lighting for a business or property should not mean juggling separate vendors for design, installation, maintenance and takedown. Our commercial program combines all of it, we design the lighting plan, supply the materials, install on your schedule with after-hours or overnight access, maintain the display through the season, remove everything when it ends, and store it if you want the same setup ready to go again next year. One point of contact manages the account from start to finish.

This service works for the full range of commercial properties we support, storefronts, plazas, office buildings, hotels, restaurants, car dealerships, banks, malls, HOAs and condo corporations, churches and municipalities. Multi-year programs are common here, once a lighting plan is designed and approved, we can maintain and reinstall it annually, so your property does not need to reinvent the display or requote the project every year. Every program starts with a custom quote, based on a site visit or a review of your property's photos or plans.
included: Design and lighting plan for your property
Materials supplied, roofline, building outline, tree wraps and more
Installation with after-hours or overnight scheduling
Full removal once the holidays end
One point of contact managing the entire program

sections.heading: How the full commercial program works
sections.text: Everything starts with either a site visit or a review of your property's photos or plans, since a full-service commercial program needs to account for the whole scope, roofline and building outline lighting, any tree wraps or cone trees, and décor if you choose to add it. Once a design is approved, we supply and install the materials, scheduling around your business hours with after-hours or overnight access where needed. Through the season, our team handles maintenance if anything needs attention, so your property manager or facilities contact is not fielding lighting issues themselves.

sections.heading: How commercial programs are priced
sections.text: Because this service bundles design, supply, installation, maintenance, removal and storage into one program, pricing depends on the same factors as standalone commercial lighting, property size, roofline height and access, the number of trees or structures involved, and whether you are running a single season or a multi-year program. Annual renewal programs, where the same design is reinstalled and maintained each year, often work out more efficiently than requoting a new project from scratch every season, since the design and material planning is already established.

sections.heading: What to expect year over year
sections.text: For multi-year clients, this program is designed to reduce the annual workload rather than repeat it every season. After the first year, we already know your property's layout, lighting plan, and material inventory, so subsequent seasons focus on reinstalling, maintaining, and storing rather than redesigning from the beginning each time. Your point of contact stays consistent, so questions about scheduling, maintenance or renewal terms go to the same place every year rather than starting over with a new vendor conversation.

pricing: Commercial Holiday Lighting Services are always custom-quoted as a full program, covering design, supply, installation, maintenance, removal and storage together. Cost depends on property size, roofline height and access, and the scope of trees, décor or centrepiece installations included. Multi-year programs are priced with renewal in mind, and every quote starts with a site visit or a review of your property's photos or plans.

faq.q: Is this different from booking installation and décor separately?
faq.a: Yes, this program bundles design, installation, maintenance, removal and storage into one contract with a single point of contact, rather than coordinating separate bookings for lighting, décor and takedown across the season with different vendors and different invoices. It is built for properties that want one relationship managing the whole season.

faq.q: Can we renew the same lighting plan every year instead of redesigning it?
faq.a: Yes, multi-year and annual renewal options are core to this program. Once your design is approved the first season, we can maintain, reinstall and store the same plan in following years without redoing the design work or requoting the project from scratch, which saves time for both your team and ours.

faq.q: Who do we contact if something needs attention mid-season?
faq.a: Your program includes one point of contact managing the entire account, so maintenance requests, scheduling questions or any issues during the season go to the same person rather than being routed between different departments, contractors or vendors trying to figure out who owns the problem and who should respond to your call.

faq.q: What types of properties use this program?
faq.a: Storefronts, plazas, office buildings, hotels, restaurants, car dealerships, banks, malls, HOAs and condo corporations, churches and municipalities all use this program, since it is built to scale across the full range of commercial property types and portfolio sizes we service every holiday season across South-Western Ontario and the western GTA.
